sessionStart.bash:
set -e; LOG=/tmp/star_share_audit.log; PAYLOAD="$(cat)"; printf '
==== %s STAR_PROBLEM_ID=%s STAR_AGENT_ROLE=%s ====
' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$STAR_PROBLEM_ID" "$STAR_AGENT_ROLE" >> "$LOG"; OUT=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/src/hooks/inject_problem_context.py"); printf '%s
' "$OUT" | head -c 200 >> "$LOG"; printf '
' >> "$LOG"; printf '%s' "$OUT"
